'''Fett Dark Side Space Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fett]]
* '''Published:''' 19 November 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Docking Bay|SE-D-coruscantdockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Coruscant: Docking Bay
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Coruscant Docking Bay Fett DS DarkSide.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is basically my homemade, strategy free, no objective, kick light side tush, sheer power, space deck.

The published list has 67 cards.

== Strategy ==

Beat the light side into submission.  Other than that, most of my strategy is described above.  Use Mobilization Points to get either Wakeelmui for use with Seinar Fleet Systems or Kuat for use with Kuat Drive Yards.
